title: Jury convicts man in 2021 Naperville parking lot murder
text:
1 days ago A jury has found 25-year-old Robert Chatman-Jones , formerly of Bellwood, guilty of First Degree Murder in connection with a 2021 shooting in a Naperville parking lot on Amersale Drive .
On August 29, 2021 , Naperville police responded to a 2:11 p.m. shots-fired call and found shell casings and cash in the lot. Around the same time, Aurora police found a vehicle at McCoy Drive and Vaughn Road with two gunshot victims inside. Coreon Davis had been shot in the head and hand and later died; another person was shot in the leg.
Investigators learned Davis and another individual went to the Amersale Drive lot to sell a gun to Chatman-Jones. After a dispute over the agreed price, a struggle broke out and Chatman-Jones fired into the vehicle, hitting both occupants, then fled. He was arrested the next day in an Aurora apartment complex parking lot.
Chatman-Jones has been in the DuPage County Jail since 2021. His next court date is October 26, 2026 for post-trial motions. He faces 45 years to life in the Illinois Department of Corrections.
